endpoints.title: Own endpoint list (optional)
endpoints.description: Leave empty to scan the community registry (github.com/OParl/resources, fetched at run time). Fill it to check your own candidates, e.g. ["https://www.leipzig.sitzung-online.de/oparl/system", "https://bochum.ratsinfomanagement.net/webservice/oparl/v1.1/system"].

filterText.title: Only endpoints containing this text
filterText.description: Substring match on the endpoint URL or the municipality title, e.g. "sitzung-online" or "dresden". Empty means no filter.

maxEndpoints.title: Maximum endpoints to check
maxEndpoints.description: Endpoints are sorted by URL before the cap is applied, so the covered set is predictable. The report always says how many were skipped.

probeAllCollections.title: Probe all eleven OParl collections
probeAllCollections.description: Off probes meetings, papers and organizations only (3 requests per endpoint). On probes all eleven, which is about four times the requests and the slower, more expensive run.

concurrency.title: Endpoints checked in parallel
concurrency.description: Keep this low: municipal servers are shared public infrastructure and rate-limit.

timeoutSeconds.title: Per-request timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a single request may take before the endpoint counts as unreachable. Municipal servers are sometimes slow; 15 is usually enough.
